user.title: Runic.io API
user.description: Enter the API token issued by Runic Support (runic@runic.io).

webhook.title: Runic.io webhook
webhook.description:
1. Open [Runic webhooks]({portal_url}) and add an endpoint with this URL:

`{webhook_url}`

2. Select the alert types you want in Home Assistant.
3. Paste the signing secret (`whsec_…`) below.

Alerts only fire for vehicles covered by an alert rule in the Runic app.

delivery.title: How should alerts reach Home Assistant?
delivery.description: Both need an endpoint in the [Runic portal]({portal_url}) with the alert types you want, and an alert rule for each type in the Runic app.

menu_options.stream: Real-time stream (recommended): no public URL needed. Add a “Real-time stream” endpoint in the portal.
menu_options.webhook: Webhook: Runic calls Home Assistant, which must be reachable from the internet over HTTPS.

reauth_confirm.title: New Runic API token
reauth_confirm.description: Runic no longer accepts the current token: it was revoked, expired or lost access. Enter a new token from Runic Support.

error.invalid_secret: The signing secret starts with whsec_.

abort.reauth_successful: The new token works. Runic.io is connected again.

init.title: Runic.io options
init.description: The real-time stream receives alerts without a public URL; it needs a “Real-time stream” endpoint in the Runic portal. Zone sync copies your Home Assistant zones (not passive ones) to Runic as points of interest, so Runic raises enter and leave alerts for them. It only changes the POIs it created. With an email, it also creates the enter and leave alert rules for every vehicle (Runic requires an email for each rule).

data.sync_zones: Sync Home Assistant zones to Runic points of interest
data.zone_alert_email: Email for Runic's notifications (creates enter and leave alert rules)

error.invalid_email: Enter a valid email address, or leave it empty.

zone_sync_off.message: Zone sync is off. Turn it on under Runic.io → Configure.

sync_zones.name: Sync zones to Runic
sync_zones.description: Copies Home Assistant zones to Runic points of interest now, instead of waiting for the next change.
